kpis.name: Flow Segment Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue represented by the Flow segment as of December 31, 2025.
kpis.description: The Flow segment is one of three primary reporting segments at Pentair, including flow solutions for industrial and commercial applications.
kpis.signal: Major business segment representing more than one-third of total revenue.

kpis.name: Water Solutions Segment Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue represented by the Water Solutions segment as of December 31, 2025.
kpis.description: The Water Solutions segment was reorganized effective January 1, 2026 to include residential and irrigation operations previously in the Flow segment.
kpis.signal: Growth segment with potential upside from the January 2026 reorganization.

kpis.name: Pool Segment Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue represented by the Pool segment as of December 31, 2025.
kpis.description: The Pool segment remains unchanged following the January 2026 reorganization and remains Pentair's largest segment.
kpis.signal: Largest segment in terms of contribution to total revenue.

kpis.name: Hydra-Stop Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Hydra-Stop, LLC for $292.1 million within the Flow segment.
kpis.description: Hydra-Stop manufactures specialized insert valves, line-stop fittings, and installation equipment for industrial applications.
kpis.signal: Strategic reinforcement in the Flow segment for specialized insert valves.

kpis.name: G F Manufacturing Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of G F Manufacturing, LLC for $116.0 million within the Pool segment.
kpis.description: G F Manufacturing manufactures and services heat pumps for swimming pools, complementing the Pool segment's product offering.
kpis.signal: Expansion into the pool heat pump market and enhancement of service capabilities.
